name: Create detailed timelines for fictional and alternate histories
description: Users asked the AI to create detailed, structured timelines or historical accounts for a wide variety of scenarios, ranging from realistic alternate histories and fictional future histories to specific crossover fanfics and original world-building projects. These requests frequently specified particular formats, such as year-by-year entries, Wikipedia-style documentation, or narrative chapters, often incorporating specific franchises or invented geopolitical events.
